mentions.description: A modern Telnet client and terminal emulator for 68k Macintosh systems running System 6, with a fully working implementation supporting VT100, VT220, xterm, glyph/emoji support, and dark/light mode, running on real hardware.
mentions.problem: A more modern Telnet client was needed for 68k Macintosh systems running System 6.
mentions.source_excerpt: Started vibe coding a more modern Telnet client for 68k Macintosh systems running System 6 last week, and within a couple of days have a fully working terminal emulator with VT100, VT220, xterm, glyph/emoji support, and dark/light mode.
